title: Incandescent
subtitle: Lux — light, flight, brilliance
text: Incandescent blood is Lux: light, elevation, radiance, and spectacle. It does not hide itself. It expands, illuminates, and travels outward because containment is foreign to it. Early records describe Lux-tended Hemomancers as difficult to look at directly, not metaphorically; their blood had become so saturated with outward force that it glowed. The Incandescent enzyme is the modern sign for that brightness.
